startup.hostnameRequirement: exact absolute HTTP(S) origin; orchestrator validates routing and effective discovery issuer
startup.importRequirement: exactly one entry in import storage: readable regular realm file without symbolic-link ancestors; matching JSON realm validated externally

default.grantTypesMeaning: required startup qualification capability; native refresh issuance is not disabled or qualified by this list
default.callbackRequirement: one exact absolute HTTP(S) URI; no wildcard, userinfo or fragment
default.templateHandling: copy only in default mode with private permissions; native Keycloak environment placeholders

project.descriptor: non-secret profile.json, externally compared with final native import

orderedChecks: exact expected realm issuer and discovery endpoints
usable public signing JWKS from the expected realm

lifecycle.automatedState: fresh owned writable state per run
lifecycle.secrets: generated at runtime; never image layers, build arguments, Git or public receipts
lifecycle.imageSelection: resolve and freeze local image IDs in one engine connection/store before starting
lifecycle.rebuild: rebuild base, rebuild derived image without pulling unpublished base, recreate container
